app.name: Weekbeat
app.tagline: Your week for movement and wellness

week.title: Week {{week}}
week.hint: Weekbeat proposes your week, with one line on why. You decide what to take.

footer.disclaimer: Fitness and wellness, not medical advice. Your data stays on this device.

setup.title: Welcome to Weekbeat
setup.intro: A few details, then you plan your first week. Everything stays on this device.
setup.availabilityHint: Add the time windows when exercise usually fits. You can change them any time.
setup.prefsIntro: A few short questions so Weekbeat can plan your week. You can skip them and answer later in the settings.

profile.name: First name
profile.sessionMinHint: Optional. Lets Weekbeat suggest sessions that fit your time windows.

availability.invalid: Please choose a valid time; the end must be after the start.

errors.name: Please enter a name.
errors.household: Please enter a name for the household.
errors.goal: The weekly goal must be a whole number from 1.
errors.sessionMin: The length must be a whole number of at least 1.
errors.hobbies: Please choose activities from the list.
errors.linkedTo: This add-on membership does not fit: it needs a main membership of the same provider that is not an add-on itself.
errors.monthlyCostShareEur: The amount must be a number from 0.
errors.singleVisitPriceEur: The single-visit price must be a number from 0.
errors.placeName: Please enter a name for the place.
errors.travelMin: Travel time must be a whole number of minutes.
errors.bookingUrl: Please enter a link that starts with https://.
errors.dailyCheckInLimit: The daily limit must be a whole number from 1, or stay empty.
errors.monthlyCheckInLimit: The monthly limit must be a whole number from 1, or stay empty.
errors.monthlyVisitLimit: The visit limit must be a whole number from 1, or stay empty.

data.title: Your data
data.explain: Everything lives only on this device. Save it as a file to move it to another device or keep a backup.
data.confirmText: This replaces all data on this device.

errors.not-json: The file could not be read.
errors.not-weekbeat: This is not a Weekbeat export file.
errors.too-new: The file comes from a newer Weekbeat version. Please update the app.
errors.bad-table: The file is damaged or incomplete.

hobbies.title: What do you like to do, {{name}}?
hobbies.hint: Pick everything that fits, including things you would like to try. Weekbeat plans from these and adds what complements them.

length.title: How long is a session usually?
length.hint: In minutes. Leave it empty if it varies a lot.

auto.title: Should Weekbeat propose your week automatically?
auto.hint: On Sunday, or as soon as a new week has no plan yet. You confirm every proposal yourself and can change this any time in the settings.
auto.no: No, I will start planning myself

membership.title: Do you have a membership, {{name}}?
membership.hint: For example Wellpass, Urban Sports Club, Wellhub or your own gym. You add its places afterwards under “Places”.

plan.replanTitle: How would you like to continue?
plan.nothing: There is no proposal for this week right now.

membership.title: Memberships
membership.works: Weekbeat works only with what you enter. There is no connection to the provider, and nothing leaves this device.
membership.shareHint: What you pay yourself, for example after your employer’s subsidy. 0 is fine too.
membership.confirmRemove: Really remove {{label}}? The places stay; only their link to this membership goes.
membership.factsTitle: Good to know, according to the provider
membership.factsReviewed: Last checked: {{date}}. What the provider shows in its app is what counts.
membership.limitsHint: As your plan states them. Leave empty if there are none. Weekbeat then plans no more visits than that.
membership.limitsStated_one: Leave empty to use what the provider states: from {{date}} at most {{count}} check-in per month.
membership.limitsStated_other: Leave empty to use what the provider states: from {{date}} at most {{count}} check-ins per month.
membership.limitFromSummary: from {{date}}: at most {{count}} check-ins per month

places.title: Places
places.intro: Your own list: gyms, clubs, routes and home. Weekbeat plans only with places listed here.
places.none: No places yet. Without places, Weekbeat plans sessions that work anywhere.
places.name: Name
places.coveredHint: Ticking a main membership also ticks its add-on (for example Plus 1). Untick it where it does not apply.
places.noMemberships: No membership yet. You can add one above and link it here.
places.equipmentHint: For example: kettlebells, barbell, pull-up bar.
places.hoursNone: No opening hours: Weekbeat assumes the place is always open.
places.priceHint: What a visit would cost without a membership. Your own figure; it later shows what your visits were worth.
places.confirmRemove: Really remove {{name}}? Sessions you already accepted stay in the plan.
places.visitLimit: Visits per month at this place (optional)
places.visitLimitHint: Only if the provider states a limit for this venue (for example on an Urban Sports Club venue profile).

checkIn.title: Check-in at {{place}} ({{name}})
checkIn.planned: This is my planned session: {{activity}} at {{time}}
checkIn.hint: Saved on this device only. Check in with the provider in its app as usual.

value.title: {{month}} with your memberships ({{name}})
value.worth_one: Worth at single-visit prices ({{count}} visit with a price)
value.worth_other: Worth at single-visit prices ({{count}} visits with a price)
value.hint: Single-visit prices are your own entries under “Places”. Just for information.
